title: OpenRacer: A web based vehicle simulator
author: Multifunkmultimedia

comments.author: Low_Imagination_9670
comments.body:
would you be interested in posting it on [pwned.games](http://pwned.games) as well?

we're super early in the building stage, and payments are not yet live but will be very soon, together with a marketing plan to attract gamers and other creators

replies.author: Multifunkmultimedia
replies.body: Thanks for reaching out! OpenRacer is a fairly large browser game (separate car/track assets, keyboard/gamepad driving), so it doesn’t fit your single-HTML room-kit format right now. Happy to keep an eye on [pwned.games](http://pwned.games) as it grows though, good luck with the launch!

replies.author: Multifunkmultimedia
replies.body:
It's about 165 MB of assets in total: 8 soft-body cars and 6 tracks as 3D models, plus \~130k lines of JavaScript for the physics and game. Players only download the car and track they pick, but it's still far beyond a single HTML file.

It's also open source and free, so selling it isn't really what I'm after.
